verdict.rationale: The only API-side evidence is that the Broadcasts API lets you 'review broadcast history' (bento-docs-34), and Bento claims it ties revenue back to the email or flow that preceded it (bento-docs-6). Nothing shows that performance metrics such as opens, clicks, conversions or attributed revenue can be pulled out through the API for a warehouse or dashboard. Missing for 10: a documented reporting/stats endpoint for campaign metrics, any API access to flow/workflow/sequence performance, API export of revenue attribution, warehouse or BI export guidance, and hands-on corroboration.
